newsitem.title: FINLAND: ALHO SEES NON-INFLATIONARY 1998 PAY RISES - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: ALHO SEES NON-INFLATIONARY 1998 PAY RISES - RFTV.

text.p: Finnish second finance minister Arja Alho said on Monday she expected trade unions and employers to agree on an incomes settlememt for 1998 which would keep inflation under control.

"I think that most of the people and most of the social partners in Finland think that employment is so important that we can get a reasonable pay agreement and that means that inflation will be in control," Alho told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV) in an interview.
"There might be some problems ... because there are some interests especially in the paper and forest industry that differ from the ideas generally of the trade unions," she said.
Alho spoke to RFTV at the sidelines meeting in Paris of ministers from the 29 OECD countries.
Finland's social partners are scheduled to start talks late this year on an incomes settlement from February 1998 onwards.
